title: Perfect Clustering in Extremely Sparse Multilayer Networks with Groupwise Subspace Structure
abstract: arXiv:2507.19423v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The paper studies a multilayer network on the same collection of nodes, where each layer follows the Generalized Random Dot Product Graph Model. Furthermore, all layers can be partitioned into groups, each group with its own unique latent subspace structure, but otherwise the matrices of connection probabilities can all be different. This setting is extremely general and includes most multilayer network models as special cases. In addition, we are interested in the situation where the layer networks may be extremely sparse and, therefore, the layer-by-layer analysis is unreliable. This problem can also be seen as a generalization of the classic setting in which one recovers a shared structure across an entire collection of matrices, extending it to the case where such structures are shared only within specific groups of matrices. translated_title: 具有分组子空间结构的极稀疏多层网络中的完美聚类
translated_abstract: 本文研究了建立在同一节点集合上的多层网络，其中每一层都遵循广义随机点积图模型。此外，所有层可以被划分为若干组，每组拥有其独特的潜在子空间结构，而除此之外各层的连接概率矩阵可以各不相同。这一设置极其广泛，将大多数多层网络模型都作为特例包含在内。同时，我们关注层网络可能极度稀疏的情形，在这种情况下逐层分析是不可靠的。该问题也可以被视为经典问题的推广：从一整个矩阵集合中恢复共享结构，扩展到结构仅在特定矩阵组内共享的情形。此设置下的关键任务是恢复具有唯一子空间结构的层分组。
tldr: 本文提出一个极其广义的多层网络聚类模型——各层遵循广义随机点积图模型且可按潜在子空间结构分组，并证明了即使各层网络极度稀疏、逐层分析失效时，仍能完美地恢复具有不同子空间结构的层分组。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an extremely general multilayer network clustering framework where layers follow the Generalized Random Dot Product Graph Model and can be partitioned into groups with distinct latent subspace structures, showing that perfect clustering of these layer groups is achievable even when the networks are extremely sparse and layer-by-layer analysis fails.
